real_dollars: All outputs in 2026 dollars unless labelled nominal.

SELL_A.label: Sell Property A now, invest in one lump

SELL_A_PHASED.label: Sell now, park 2-3 yrs in 3M-2Y Treasuries, then phase into stocks (mixed)

base.label: Base case
base.desc: Central inputs; owner figures where supplied; assumptions as documented.

downside.label: Downside (all adverse ends)
downside.desc: Every input set to the end of its range that hurts household wealth.

upside.label: Upside (all favourable ends)
upside.desc: Every input set to the end of its range that helps household wealth.

stagflation.label: 1970s-style stagflation
stagflation.desc: Inflation 5.5% for 2027-2029 then 3.5%; stocks 4%; cash 5%; housing 1 point below inflation in real terms.

lost_decade.label: Lost decade (flat stocks, 10 years)
lost_decade.desc: Stock return 1% a year for the first 10 years after transfer, then base case.

crash_1929.label: 1929-style crash at transfer
crash_1929.desc: Stocks fall 87% over 36 months from transfer (Fed History reports -89% 1929-1932; calibrated approximately). Housing -30% over 3 years (ASSUMED analogue). Cash falls to 2.5% (deflation response).

crash_2008.label: 2008-style crash at transfer
crash_2008.desc: Stocks fall 57% over 17 months from transfer (Fed History: S&P 500 -57%, Oct 2007-Mar 2009). Housing -30% over 24 months (Fed History: about -30%).

rate_cut.label: Reinvestment shock: cash yields fall to 2.5%
rate_cut.desc: Short-term yields fall to 2.5% for three years, starting one year after transfer. Tests reinvestment risk of cash parked for 24-36 months.

step_up_cap.label: Reported step-up cap (UNVERIFIED proposal)
step_up_cap.desc: Basis capped at $3,000,000 at death (reported Treasury proposal; not law; text not located).

pre_prop19.label: Illustrative: Prop 19 repealed (pre-2021 rules)
pre_prop19.desc: Illustrative only (the 2026 repeal initiative did not qualify per S29). Heir keeps the factored base year value regardless of occupancy.
